items.text: I can explain what Amazon DLM is and the problem it solves
I know where to find DLM in the AWS console (EC2 → EBS → Lifecycle Manager)
I understand the two DLM policy types: EBS snapshot and EBS-backed AMI
I can explain the difference between custom policy and default policy
I understand tag-based selection and how DLM finds target resources
I know the two retention modes: count-based and age-based, and when to use each
I understand what incremental snapshots are and why they reduce storage cost
I can create a DLM lifecycle policy from the AWS console
I can configure schedule frequency, start time, and retention in a policy
I can enable cross-region copy in a DLM policy for DR
I can tag EBS volumes correctly so DLM targets them
I can verify a DLM policy is enabled and check its details in the console
I can clean up a DLM policy and its associated snapshots after testing
I know DLM is free — you only pay for snapshot storage
I know the minimum DLM frequency is 1 hour
I know DLM does NOT manage RDS snapshots or S3 versioning
I can differentiate DLM from AWS Backup in exam scenarios
I know DLM uses AWSDataLifecycleManagerDefaultRole automatically
I know snapshots inherit encryption from the source EBS volume
